sources.title: Monzo Help - What are Instant Access Savings Pots?
Bank & savings protection checker | Check your money is protected | FSCS

brands.evidence: Yes. If Monzo Bank fails, the UK's Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) protects up to £120,000 per person

client_claims.text: FSCS protects up to £120,000 per person in eligible cash deposits held with Monzo.
Monzo is a licensed UK bank, so its customers get the same deposit protection as customers of a UK high-street bank.
client_claims.note: Monzo is a UK bank authorised by the PRA with FSCS protection.

client_claims.text: In most cases, the FSCS pays you back automatically within seven working days; you don't need to make a claim.
client_claims.note: Payout timing is not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: Add together your Monzo current account, regular Pots, savings held by Monzo itself and your share of any joint account; if the total is £120,000 or less, eligible cash is fully covered.
client_claims.note: Consistent with the £120,000 per person limit.

client_claims.text: Two joint holders can have up to £240,000 covered between them, provided neither exceeds their individual limit.
client_claims.note: Joint account coverage is not stated in the facts.
